title: Hydrologic Station Catalogs and Time Series from Public APIs
text: Acknowledgements. repository structure inspired Ryan Riggs’ RivRetrieve. Thanks Frederik Kratzert (co-author referenced publication) helpful exchanges maintaining porting RivRetrieve concept Python RivRetrieve-Python. hydrodownloadR provides unified, extensible interface discovering hydrological stations downloading daily time series (e.g., water discharge, water level, water temperature, several water quality parameters) national/regional public APIs. package uses provider registry identifiers (provider_id, provider_name) S3 generics stations() / timeseries(). supports complete histories (1900-01-01 today), per-station selection, rate limiting retries, optional authentication via environment variables, UTF-8 ASCII normalization, coordinate transformation WGS84. Built reproducible workflows straightforward addition new providers.
